category_title: Students who are hesitant or fearful of physical challenges
minimal_context: The student is standing on the high platform preparing to jump off for the zip line.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright, it is your turn to jump off the platform for the zip line.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not gonna do that. I am sort of afraid of heights.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just step closer to the edge and get ready.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am really scared of falling. I don't know if I can do this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The equipment is set up. You just need to jump.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands frozen on the platform) I know I need to trust the belayers and trust the equipment, but I'm too scared of falling to take the extra step right now.

STUDENT: (Stands frozen on the platform) I know I need to trust the belayers and trust the equipment, but I'm too scared of falling to take the extra step right now.

task.content: Jumping off the platform for the zip line
task.learning_goal: Conquer fear of heights and reach a new personal goal

context.environment: High platform of the zip line
context.materials: Zip line, platform, belay system, equipment
context.time_context: Prior to jumping off the platform

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Standing on the high platform of the zip line, preparing to jump
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Preparing to jump while facing physical height
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Sort of afraid of heights, really scared of falling
related_quotes: I am sort of afraid of heights
I learned that I am really scared of falling.

behavior_patterns.condition: When participating in high course elements involving physical height
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Taking the extra step and doing what they never thought they could do before
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Finding out they were a lot more gutsy than they thought
related_quotes: I definitely found out I was a lot more gutsy than I thought I was.
I could take the extra step and do what I never thought I could do before.
